newsitem.title: UK: BP pares loss, BP stake seen mostly placed.
newsitem.headline: BP pares loss, BP stake seen mostly placed.

text.p: Shares in British Petroleum Co Plc bounced from an early markdown on Thursday, with a placing of three percent of its stock seen as having been largely completed in the U.S. on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The stock was mainly placed in the U.S. yesterday and the buyers are coming back in today," said the head of equity trading at one brokerage.
After initially dropping 22p, BP shares were down just 9p at 735-1/2 by 0834 GMT in active trade of 6.1 million shares -- making BP the second most active stock in the London market at that point.
Analysts said the placing had little bearing on BP shares beyond a short-term mark-down, adding that BP shares could rally further when Wall Street opens and responds to the completion of the deal.

"Any weakness...is a truly unique opportunity to buy into one of the best-managed of the major oil companies, with superior earnings, cash flow and profitability growth," said Sean Reynolds, analyst at Lehman Brothers.

The Lehman analyst said BP's first-quarter results on May 6, showing a greater-than-expected 19 percent rise in net earnings to 755 million stg, demonstrated its appeal. "It is fundamentally a fantastic story," he said.
Goldman said the placing had met with "substanial" demand, spread between the U.S., continental Europe, the UK and Far East, though a spokesman declined to say if all the stock had been placed.
